title: Making Everyone the Director of Their Own Life
summary: PixVerse reports that creator @nerdsoul gained 300,000 followers and 210 million views in two months, alongside a separate AI-film festival example.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: PixVerse describes @nerdsoul’s AI-generated character videos and their reported audience growth. It also describes an unnamed Portuguese creator’s 30-minute film selected for Fantasporto. Earnings, preserved livelihoods, and population-level reductions in inequality remain unestablished.
purpose: Make video creation accessible with generative AI.

ratings.reason: Creator @nerdsoul reportedly used PixVerse to gain 300,000 followers and 210 million views in two months, a measurable creative-reach result.
Brand and educator applications are described in general, without a specified operational or revenue improvement.
The 1.4 million hashtagged videos measure activity, not reduced inequality or a population benefit.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: Making Everyone the Director of Their Own Life

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: PixVerse expands a creator’s reach and supports AI filmmaking
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
